lang.name: English
app.title: Commscribe
app.tagline: Radio log with real-time transcription and translation.
app.legal: Check local rules on recording radio communication before use.
app.license: Open source under the Apache License 2.0.
empty.title: No transmissions yet
empty.hint: Press <kbd>Start listening</kbd> and each transmission will appear here as it is sent.
empty.upload_hint: Or drop an audio file here — meetings, dictations and recordings from other devices are transcribed the same way.
empty.upload_hint_server: Press Upload, or drop an audio file into the window. Everything is transcribed here on the server; nothing is sent out.
card.dropped: The queue was full — the audio is saved.
toast.device_change: Stop and start listening to switch device.
settings.title: Settings
audio.device_hint: The sound card the radio is connected to. Aim for peaks around −12 dBFS.
audio.monitor: Monitor — play the radio through the speaker
audio.threshold_hint: The level that counts as speech. Lower it if weak stations are missed, raise it if noise triggers recordings. The threshold is shown as a line in the level meter.
audio.min_hint: Shorter transmissions are discarded. Counters hallucinations from clicks and squelch tails.
audio.hangover_hint: Silence before the segment is closed. Longer keeps pauses within one transmission together.
audio.preroll_hint: Audio kept from before the threshold was crossed, so the first syllable is not cut off.
text.engine_local: Local — everything happens on this machine
text.engine_cloud: Cloud API — faster, needs a key
text.engine_hint_local: Local transcription sends nothing off the machine and works without internet.
text.engine_hint_cloud: The audio is sent to the provider chosen under Cloud. Needs an API key.
text.engine_hint_ollama: Ollama cannot transcribe audio. Choose Local here, or Groq/OpenAI under Cloud.
text.language_hint: Set the language explicitly when you know it — auto misses on short transmissions.
text.translate_hint_en: English is done by Whisper itself — no key needed.
text.translate_hint_ollama: Languages other than English are translated by Ollama, locally and without a key.
text.translate_hint_cloud: Languages other than English go through the cloud API and need a key under Cloud.
text.threads_hint: More threads transcribe faster, but leave less machine for everything else.
text.beam_hint: Higher values search wider for the best interpretation. Slower.
models.hint: Models are downloaded once and then used without internet. NB-Whisper is trained on Norwegian and is clearly best on Norwegian radio.
models.notes.nb-whisper-tiny: Fastest. For weak machines or a keyword-only log.
models.notes.nb-whisper-small: Recommended. Good balance of speed and accuracy.
models.notes.nb-whisper-medium: Best on noisy radio. Needs a quick machine.
models.notes.nb-whisper-large: Highest quality. Slow without a GPU.
models.notes.faster-whisper-small: OpenAI weights. Use this when the radio is not Norwegian.
cloud.hint: Cloud APIs are faster than local transcription, but send the audio off the machine. Keys are stored only on this machine.
cloud.hint_ollama: Ollama is a language model running on your own machine or on the server. Nothing is sent out, and no key is needed.
cloud.provider_ollama: Ollama — language model on your own machine
cloud.key_saved: A key is saved. Enter a new one to replace it, or save empty to remove it.
cloud.key_none: No key saved for this provider.
cloud.ollama_url_hint: On NOMAD this is http://nomad_ollama:11434 — the AI Assistant's own Ollama. Ollama does not transcribe audio; it is used for translation, and the engine under Text must be Local.
cloud.ollama_model_placeholder: empty = the first one Ollama has
about.retention_hint: Older recordings and transcripts are deleted at startup.
about.confirm_clear: Delete the whole log? Both text and audio recordings are removed permanently.
setup.capture_intro: Connect the radio's speaker output to the sound card, and pick it here. Everything that comes in is split into transmissions and written out as text.
setup.meter_hint: Turn the radio on — the bar should move when someone transmits.
setup.server_intro: This installation has no audio input — it runs on a server. Upload audio files with Upload or by dropping them into the window, and they are transcribed here, on the server, without anything being sent out.
setup.server_hint: To log a radio, run the desktop app where the sound card is. It exists for macOS, Windows and Linux.
setup.model_intro: The model runs on your machine. Nothing leaves the building. It is downloaded once.
setup.ready_capture: Press Start listening and every transmission is logged with time, audio and text. Adjust the threshold under Settings if weak stations are missed or noise triggers recordings.
setup.ready_edit: Click the text in a card to correct it
setup.ready_upload: Press Upload, or drop an audio file into the window. Every recording is logged with time, audio and text, and can be exported as text, Markdown, CSV, subtitles or JSON.
setup.ready_translate: Translation is enabled under Settings → Text
